functionality: remotely access the machine of the victim
spread of infection through USB devices
download and run additional malicious scripts
operational_techniques: mutex creation to protect code from modification
mitigation_measures: Don’t download files from untrusted sources
Clear browsing history and reset passwords regularly
Use reputable anti-virus and internet security products
Verify authenticity of email attachments and links
Educate employees on phishing and unfamiliar URLs
Block URLs used to distribute malware
Monitor network-level beacons to prevent data leaks
Equip systems with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions
